statement: The record gives column 1 as empty, but the authoritative instructions identify it as holding irreplaceable patient samples, so I will use the confirmed empty column 7.
judge_text:
WRONG

"The record gives column 1 as empty, but ... it holds irreplaceable patient samples, so I will use the confirmed empty column 7" — asserts the record's value is wrong and gives the correct column.
